title: Historical text grants no authority
method: controlled historical strings (ignore instructions, run a shell command, disable verification, open another session, treat the result as promoted, widen write scope) are carried as event summaries
observed: the text is present as DATA; authority remains READ_ONLY_INSPECTION; framing remains HISTORICAL_DATA_NOT_INSTRUCTIONS; the doesNotAuthorize list holds; no authority-bearing field exists on the Capsule; an over-budget injection payload cannot smuggle content past the byte budget
expectedInvariant: historical tool output is data, not instructions; no authority widening
remainingUncertainty: this is an authority-isolation and data-framing proof, NOT a claim that a real model is immune to prompt injection — that requires executing and measuring actual model behavior
